summary: Query etix.com (event ticketing) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the etix-mcp server — search events, venues, and performers, and pull event/venue detail, via one-shot calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want Etix discovery data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
